title: GitHub - SteveVitali/agent-skills: Research-grounded, harness-agnostic skills for AI coding agents
excerpt: Research-grounded, harness-agnostic skills for AI coding agents - SteveVitali/agent-skills
content_html:
Rigorous engineering process for AI coding agents, packaged as portable Agent Skills: implement a spec end to end to a verified PR, review code with independent judgment — your own branch, or anyone's PR — work through review feedback like a professional author, and keep documentation (agent-facing and human-facing) converged with the code it describes.

  • Harness-agnostic — standard SKILL.md directories. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and a growing list of clients load them natively; anywhere else (Windsurf, Goose, a human with a terminal), a one-line pointer to the skill file works.
  • Codebase-agnostic — no assumptions about your repo, language, or toolchain. Build/test/lint commands are discovered from the repo or passed as inputs, never hardcoded.
  • Research-grounded — durable ledgers, fresh-context review, evidence-first reporting: the design decisions trace to the agent-engineering literature (rationale).

The flagship: implement-spec

Most agents can write plausible code from a spec. What they don't do reliably is everything around that — hold the plan across a long horizon, test what they wrote, catch where the implementation quietly diverges from the spec, and prove the result rather than assert it. implement-spec packages that discipline: hand it an agent-ready spec, and it runs the lifecycle autonomously, surfacing only at the end.

spec ─▶ branch ─▶ plan + test matrix ─▶ implement (tests alongside)
     ─▶ two-pass self-review ─▶ gap analysis vs the spec ─▶ close gaps
     ─▶ live verification ─▶ PR + acceptance-criteria evidence report
  • Evidence over claims — "done" means every acceptance criterion in the final report maps to a verifiable artifact (a test, a command's output, a live check) — not that the model says so.
  • Survives long horizons — a durable run ledger on disk makes the run resumable across crashes and context compaction.
  • Proportional rigor — every heavyweight phase (ledger, self-review, gap analysis, tests, live verification) is individually opt-out, so a one-line fix doesn't pay a ten-phase tax.

The full design rationale, with the literature behind each phase, is in skills/implement-spec/README.md.

The skills around it

Seven more skills stand alongside it — two scale it across sessions, the rest review, answer, and document:

Skill Purpose
decompose-spec Split one large spec into the fewest self-contained tickets that each fit a single fresh context, and seed a durable build ledger — the planning half of a multi-session build
orchestrate-build Drive that ledger to completion: run each ticket through implement-spec in a fresh context, report progress, pause for intervention, finish with a whole-build capstone — the execution half
self-review Two-pass review of your own branch, pre-PR: mechanical verification, then independence-preserving design critique
review-pr Review someone else's PR: CI/verification grounding, focused design + security passes, calibrated severities, high-precision inline comments
address-pr-comments Work through review feedback on your PR: triage every thread, fix or push back with evidence, reply with commit links
agent-docs Bootstrap or refresh the AGENTS.md hierarchy — the agent-facing knowledge layer
refresh-repo-docs Audit and sync human-facing docs (README, docs/, examples) against the code

The multi-session build

When a spec is too large for one focused run, decompose-spec and orchestrate-build turn it into a resumable chain of PRs — implement-spec is still the per-ticket worker, run once per ticket in a fresh context:

  • decompose-spec is the planner, and the quality ceiling of the whole build: it partitions the spec to a precise objective — the fewest tickets such that each fits one fresh context with rigor headroom and no cut severs a shared implicit decision — then reviews its own split in a fresh context and seeds the build ledger. The two bounds (context rot above, fragmented decisions below) trace to the rationale.
  • orchestrate-build is the driver. Its key move: sequencing is deterministic code — a portable loop (drive-build.sh that discovers claude -p / goose run / codex exec / gemini -p) that holds no state and dispatches each ticket to a fresh context — so nothing accumulates context across the build and there is no long-lived agent context to rot. State lives in the ledger; the human pauses and intervenes at ticket boundaries by editing it. Degrades to a subagent-per-ticket or a manual fresh-session floor where a harness offers less; the rationale covers why it stays harness-agnostic.

The review suite

Three seats at the same table, sharing one epistemology — every flag must be demonstrable, and precision beats recall (false positives are how reviewers lose the room):

  • self-review is the author pre-PR: Pass 1 runs auto-discovered build/test/lint (via verify.sh, which infers the toolchain when the repo doesn't declare one) plus binary checklists; Pass 2 is design critique under independence rules — fresh context where the harness supports subagents, evidence-from-disk discipline where it doesn't. Also implement-spec's review phase.
  • review-pr is the reviewer's seat: grounded in CI and (optionally) local verification, then separate focused passes for correctness, design, security, and scope; findings gated by demonstrability → confidence → novelty → materiality, labeled blocking/important/nit/question, capped to prevent alert fatigue, posted with suggestion blocks. It informs — approval stays human.
  • address-pr-comments is the author answering: every unresolved thread gets a fix, a commit link, a reasoned push-back, an answer, or a scoped follow-up — never silence, never sycophancy, never a mid-review force-push.

The docs pair

Same convergence philosophy, two corpora with different consumers and quality bars — each with a deterministic, CI-gateable drift detector in front of the LLM work:

  • agent-docs owns the agent-facing knowledge layer (AGENTS.md hierarchy) the other skills run on. Two modes — bootstrap (reconnaissance → gotcha mining → generation) and refresh (drift triage → surgical fixes) — auto-selected by a detector that classifies broken references as went stale vs authoring error using git history. Owns the shared Doc Authoring Guidelines.
  • refresh-repo-docs owns what humans read: README, docs/, CHANGELOG, guides, examples. Its detector flags broken references and docs older than the code they cite; the audit is scoped by evidence (flagged docs, not "read the whole repo"), findings are classed stale/cruft/gap/mode-drift with Diátaxis as the per-doc quality lens, and no claim is written unverified.

Install

As a Claude Code plugin:

/plugin marketplace add SteveVitali/agent-skills
/plugin install agent-skills@agent-skills

Or by symlink, for any client that discovers skills on disk (~/.claude/skills/, a project's .agents/skills/, etc.):

git clone https://github.com/SteveVitali/agent-skills.git ~/agent-skills
ln -s ~/agent-skills/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/

Clients without native skill support (e.g. Windsurf): a one-line workflow or rule pointing at the skill file is enough — "Read and follow <path>/skills/implement-spec/SKILL.md".

Each skill declares its inputs in SKILL.md frontmatter; state them in natural language ("implement docs/spec.md, skip the ledger, base off main"). System requirements: git, bash 3.2+, and standard Unix tools; the PR skills (review-pr, address-pr-comments) additionally need an authenticated GitHub CLI (gh).

Repo layout

.claude-plugin/              # plugin + marketplace manifests (Claude Code)
skills/<skill-name>/
├── SKILL.md             # entry point (Agent Skills format: frontmatter + steps)
├── README.md            # design rationale (where it exists)
├── modes/               # mode-specific step files, loaded on demand (where applicable)
├── scripts/             # supporting shell helpers (bash 3.2+ compatible)
└── checklists/          # supporting checklists / shared reference docs (where applicable)

One predictable entry filename means an agent (or tool) pointed at skills/ knows where every skill starts; everything else in a skill directory is progressive-disclosure material referenced from its SKILL.md.

Design principles

  • Durable state over context — anything that must survive compaction or a crash goes to disk (run ledgers, snapshots, reports), never only in context.
  • External verification over self-assessment — compilers, tests, and live systems are the arbiters; an agent's claim of "done" without evidence is treated as not done.
  • Judgment independence — review happens in a fresh context where possible, and always argues from what is on disk rather than memory of writing it.
  • Deterministic before LLM — cheap, exit-code-gated scripts handle everything mechanical (drift detection, toolchain checks) so model judgment is spent only where judgment is required.
  • Progressive disclosure — hub files stay small; mode files, guidelines, and checklists load only when needed.
  • Proportional rigor — every heavyweight phase is opt-out, so a one-line fix doesn't pay a ten-phase tax.

Authoring a new skill

  1. Create skills/<name>/SKILL.md with frontmatter: name, description (what it does and when to use it), and inputs (each with name, required, description). Keep the body harness-neutral — no tool-specific directives in skill files.
  2. Write instructions that are concrete enough to verify ("run X, expect exit 0"), and calibrated to a frontier model: specify what and why, not keystroke-level how.
  3. If the skill nears the spec's ~500-line ceiling for SKILL.md or has distinct modes, split into a hub + modes/ files (see agent-docs).
  4. Shell helpers go in scripts/: bash 3.2-compatible, self-contained, read-only by default — anything mutating must say so in its header, and known limitations belong in the header too.
  5. No assumptions about repo, language, or toolchain anywhere: discover from the repo or take it as an input.

Related

  • Agent Skills — the open format these skills conform to.
  • anthropics/skills — Anthropic's reference collection; mostly capability skills (documents, design, testing tools).
  • obra/superpowers — a full interactive development methodology (brainstorm → plan → subagent-driven TDD). Kindred spirit, different center of gravity: superpowers optimizes the human-in-the-loop workflow; agent-skills optimizes the autonomous run and its evidence trail.
  • claude-hibernate — hibernate running Claude Code sessions across reboots. Began in this repo; Claude Code-specific by nature, so it lives on its own.

License

MIT

blocks.html_en: The multi-session build

sentences.en: The multi-session build
sentences.zh: 多会话构建

blocks.html_en: When a spec is too large for one focused run, decompose-spec and orchestrate-build turn it into a resumable chain of PRs — implement-spec is still the per-ticket worker, run once per ticket in a fresh context:

sentences.en: When a spec is too large for one focused run, decompose-spec and orchestrate-build turn it into a resumable chain of PRs — implement-spec is still the per-ticket worker, run once per ticket in a fresh context:
sentences.zh: 当规范对于一次集中运行而言太大时，decompose-spec 和 Orchestrate-build 将其转换为可恢复的 PR 链 - Implement-spec 仍然是按票工作人员，在新的上下文中按票运行一次：

blocks.html_en: • decompose-spec is the planner, and the quality ceiling of the whole build: it partitions the spec to a precise objective — the fewest tickets such that each fits one fresh context with rigor headroom and no cut severs a shared implicit decision — then reviews its own split in a fresh context and seeds the build ledger. The two bounds (context rot above, fragmented decisions below) trace to the rationale.

sentences.en: decompose-spec is the planner, and the quality ceiling of the whole build: it partitions the spec to a precise objective — the fewest tickets such that each fits one fresh context with rigor headroom and no cut severs a shared implicit decision — then reviews its own split in a fresh context and seeds the build ledger.
sentences.zh: decompose-spec 是规划者，是整个构建的质量上限：它将规范划分为一个精确的目标——最少的票数，使得每个都适合一个具有严格空间的新上下文，并且没有削减切断共享的隐式决策——然后在新的上下文中审查它自己的分割，并为构建分类账播种。

sentences.en: The two bounds (context rot above, fragmented decisions below) trace to the rationale.
sentences.zh: 这两个界限（上面的上下文腐烂，下面的支离破碎的决策）追溯到基本原理。

blocks.html_en: • orchestrate-build is the driver. Its key move: sequencing is deterministic code — a portable loop (drive-build.sh that discovers claude -p / goose run / codex exec / gemini -p) that holds no state and dispatches each ticket to a fresh context — so nothing accumulates context across the build and there is no long-lived agent context to rot. State lives in the ledger; the human pauses and intervenes at ticket boundaries by editing it. Degrades to a subagent-per-ticket or a manual fresh-session floor where a harness offers less; the rationale covers why it stays harness-agnostic.

sentences.en: orchestrate-build is the driver.
sentences.zh: Orchestrate-build 是驱动程序。

sentences.en: Its key move: sequencing is deterministic code — a portable loop (drive-build.sh that discovers claude -p / goose run / codex exec / gemini -p) that holds no state and dispatches each ticket to a fresh context — so nothing accumulates context across the build and there is no long-lived agent context to rot.
sentences.zh: 它的关键举措：排序是确定性代码 - 一个可移植的循环（drive-build.sh，发现 claude -p / goose run / codex exec / gemini -p），不保留任何状态并将每个票证分派到新的上下文 - 因此没有任何内容会在构建过程中积累上下文，并且不会出现长期存在的代理上下文。

sentences.en: State lives in the ledger; the human pauses and intervenes at ticket boundaries by editing it.
sentences.zh: 状态存在于账本中；人类会在票证边界处暂停并通过编辑进行干预。

sentences.en: Degrades to a subagent-per-ticket or a manual fresh-session floor where a harness offers less; the rationale covers why it stays harness-agnostic.
sentences.zh: 降级为每票一个子座席或手动新鲜会话楼层，其中安全带提供的服务较少；基本原理涵盖了为什么它与线束无关。

blocks.html_en: The review suite

sentences.en: The review suite
sentences.zh: 审查套件

blocks.html_en: Three seats at the same table, sharing one epistemology — every flag must be demonstrable, and precision beats recall (false positives are how reviewers lose the room):

sentences.en: Three seats at the same table, sharing one epistemology — every flag must be demonstrable, and precision beats recall (false positives are how reviewers lose the room):
sentences.zh: 同一张桌子上的三个座位，共享一个认识论——每一个标志都必须是可证明的，精确性胜过回忆（误报是审稿人失去房间的原因）：

blocks.html_en: • self-review is the author pre-PR: Pass 1 runs auto-discovered build/test/lint (via verify.sh, which infers the toolchain when the repo doesn't declare one) plus binary checklists; Pass 2 is design critique under independence rules — fresh context where the harness supports subagents, evidence-from-disk discipline where it doesn't. Also implement-spec's review phase.

sentences.en: self-review is the author pre-PR: Pass 1 runs auto-discovered build/test/lint (via verify.sh, which infers the toolchain when the repo doesn't declare one) plus binary checklists; Pass 2 is design critique under independence rules — fresh context where the harness supports subagents, evidence-from-disk discipline where it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 自我审查是作者预 PR：第 1 遍运行自动发现的构建/测试/lint（通过 verify.sh，当存储库未声明工具链时推断工具链）加上二进制检查表；第 2 阶段是独立规则下的设计批判——在新的环境中，线束支持子代理，在不支持的情况下，采用磁盘证据规则。

sentences.en: Also implement-spec's review phase.
sentences.zh: 还实施规范的审查阶段。

blocks.html_en: • review-pr is the reviewer's seat: grounded in CI and (optionally) local verification, then separate focused passes for correctness, design, security, and scope; findings gated by demonstrability → confidence → novelty → materiality, labeled blocking/important/nit/question, capped to prevent alert fatigue, posted with suggestion blocks. It informs — approval stays human.

sentences.en: review-pr is the reviewer's seat: grounded in CI and (optionally) local verification, then separate focused passes for correctness, design, security, and scope; findings gated by demonstrability → confidence → novelty → materiality, labeled blocking/important/nit/question, capped to prevent alert fatigue, posted with suggestion blocks.
sentences.zh: review-pr 是审阅者的席位：以 CI 和（可选）本地验证为基础，然后针对正确性、设计、安全性和范围分别进行重点传递；通过可论证性→信心→新颖性→实质性来控制的发现，标记为阻塞/重要/nit/问题，上限以防止警报疲劳，并与建议块一起发布。

sentences.en: It informs — approval stays human.
sentences.zh: 它告诉我们——批准仍然是人性的。

blocks.html_en: • address-pr-comments is the author answering: every unresolved thread gets a fix, a commit link, a reasoned push-back, an answer, or a scoped follow-up — never silence, never sycophancy, never a mid-review force-push.

sentences.en: address-pr-comments is the author answering: every unresolved thread gets a fix, a commit link, a reasoned push-back, an answer, or a scoped follow-up — never silence, never sycophancy, never a mid-review force-push.
sentences.zh: 地址-公关-评论是作者的回答：每个未解决的线程都会得到修复、提交链接、合理的推回、答案或范围内的后续行动 - 永远不会沉默，永远不会阿谀奉承，永远不会在审核中强行推动。

sentences.en: Same convergence philosophy, two corpora with different consumers and quality bars — each with a deterministic, CI-gateable drift detector in front of the LLM work:

blocks.html_en: • agent-docs owns the agent-facing knowledge layer (AGENTS.md hierarchy) the other skills run on. Two modes — bootstrap (reconnaissance → gotcha mining → generation) and refresh (drift triage → surgical fixes) — auto-selected by a detector that classifies broken references as went stale vs authoring error using git history. Owns the shared Doc Authoring Guidelines.

sentences.en: agent-docs owns the agent-facing knowledge layer (AGENTS.md hierarchy) the other skills run on.

sentences.en: Two modes — bootstrap (reconnaissance → gotcha mining → generation) and refresh (drift triage → surgical fixes) — auto-selected by a detector that classifies broken references as went stale vs authoring error using git history.
sentences.zh: 两种模式——引导（侦察→陷阱挖掘→生成）和刷新（漂移分类→外科修复）——由检测器自动选择，该检测器将损坏的引用分类为过时与使用 git 历史记录编写错误。

sentences.en: Owns the shared Doc Authoring Guidelines.

blocks.html_en: • refresh-repo-docs owns what humans read: README, docs/, CHANGELOG, guides, examples. Its detector flags broken references and docs older than the code they cite; the audit is scoped by evidence (flagged docs, not "read the whole repo"), findings are classed stale/cruft/gap/mode-drift with Diátaxis as the per-doc quality lens, and no claim is written unverified.

sentences.en: refresh-repo-docs owns what humans read: README, docs/, CHANGELOG, guides, examples.
sentences.zh: fresh-repo-docs 拥有人类阅读的内容：README、docs/、CHANGELOG、指南、示例。

sentences.en: Its detector flags broken references and docs older than the code they cite; the audit is scoped by evidence (flagged docs, not "read the whole repo"), findings are classed stale/cruft/gap/mode-drift with Diátaxis as the per-doc quality lens, and no claim is written unverified.
sentences.zh: 它的检测器会标记损坏的引用和早于它们引用的代码的文档；审计的范围是证据（标记文档，而不是“阅读整个存储库”），结果被归类为陈旧/粗糙/差距/模式漂移，Diátaxis 作为每个文档的质量镜头，并且没有未经验证的声明。

blocks.html_en: Design principles

sentences.en: Design principles
sentences.zh: 设计原则

blocks.html_en: • Durable state over context — anything that must survive compaction or a crash goes to disk (run ledgers, snapshots, reports), never only in context.

sentences.en: Durable state over context — anything that must survive compaction or a crash goes to disk (run ledgers, snapshots, reports), never only in context.
sentences.zh: 上下文中的持久状态——任何必须在压缩或崩溃中幸存下来的东西都会写入磁盘（运行分类帐、快照、报告），而不仅仅是在上下文中。

blocks.html_en: • External verification over self-assessment — compilers, tests, and live systems are the arbiters; an agent's claim of "done" without evidence is treated as not done.

sentences.en: External verification over self-assessment — compilers, tests, and live systems are the arbiters; an agent's claim of "done" without evidence is treated as not done.
sentences.zh: 外部验证优于自我评估——编译器、测试和实时系统是仲裁者；代理人在没有证据的情况下声称“已完成”将被视为未完成。

blocks.html_en: • Judgment independence — review happens in a fresh context where possible, and always argues from what is on disk rather than memory of writing it.

sentences.en: Judgment independence — review happens in a fresh context where possible, and always argues from what is on disk rather than memory of writing it.
sentences.zh: 判断独立性——审查尽可能在新的环境中进行，并且总是根据磁盘上的内容而不是编写它的记忆来争论。

blocks.html_en: • Deterministic before LLM — cheap, exit-code-gated scripts handle everything mechanical (drift detection, toolchain checks) so model judgment is spent only where judgment is required.

sentences.en: Deterministic before LLM — cheap, exit-code-gated scripts handle everything mechanical (drift detection, toolchain checks) so model judgment is spent only where judgment is required.
sentences.zh: LLM 之前的确定性——廉价的、退出代码门控的脚本处理所有机械问题（漂移检测、工具链检查），因此模型判断仅在需要判断的地方进行。

blocks.html_en: • Progressive disclosure — hub files stay small; mode files, guidelines, and checklists load only when needed.

sentences.en: Progressive disclosure — hub files stay small; mode files, guidelines, and checklists load only when needed.
sentences.zh: 渐进式披露——中心文件保持较小；模式文件、指南和清单仅在需要时加载。

blocks.html_en: • Proportional rigor — every heavyweight phase is opt-out, so a one-line fix doesn't pay a ten-phase tax.

sentences.en: Proportional rigor — every heavyweight phase is opt-out, so a one-line fix doesn't pay a ten-phase tax.
sentences.zh: 比例严格——每个重量级阶段都可以选择退出，因此单行修复不需要支付十阶段税。

sentences.en: Authoring a new skill

blocks.html_en: • Create skills/<name>/SKILL.md with frontmatter: name, description (what it does and when to use it), and inputs (each with name, required, description). Keep the body harness-neutral — no tool-specific directives in skill files.

sentences.en: Create skills/<name>/SKILL.md with frontmatter: name, description (what it does and when to use it), and inputs (each with name, required, description).
sentences.zh: 使用 frontmatter 创建 Skills/<name>/SKILL.md：名称、描述（它的作用以及何时使用它）和输入（每个都有名称、必需、描述）。

sentences.en: Keep the body harness-neutral — no tool-specific directives in skill files.
sentences.zh: 保持身体安全带中立——技能文件中没有特定于工具的指令。

blocks.html_en: • Write instructions that are concrete enough to verify ("run X, expect exit 0"), and calibrated to a frontier model: specify what and why, not keystroke-level how.

sentences.en: Write instructions that are concrete enough to verify ("run X, expect exit 0"), and calibrated to a frontier model: specify what and why, not keystroke-level how.
sentences.zh: 编写足够具体的指令以进行验证（“运行 X，期望退出 0”），并校准到前沿模型：指定内容和原因，而不是击键级别的方式。

blocks.html_en: • If the skill nears the spec's ~500-line ceiling for SKILL.md or has distinct modes, split into a hub + modes/ files (see agent-docs).

sentences.en: If the skill nears the spec's ~500-line ceiling for SKILL.md or has distinct modes, split into a hub + modes/ files (see agent-docs).
sentences.zh: 如果技能接近 SKILL.md 规范的 ~500 行上限或具有不同的模式，则分为集线器 + 模式/文件（请参阅代理文档）。

blocks.html_en: • Shell helpers go in scripts/: bash 3.2-compatible, self-contained, read-only by default — anything mutating must say so in its header, and known limitations belong in the header too.

sentences.en: Shell helpers go in scripts/: bash 3.2-compatible, self-contained, read-only by default — anything mutating must say so in its header, and known limitations belong in the header too.
sentences.zh: Shell 帮助程序位于 script/ 中：bash 3.2 兼容、自包含、默认只读 - 任何变化都必须在其标头中说明，并且已知的限制也属于标头。

blocks.html_en: • No assumptions about repo, language, or toolchain anywhere: discover from the repo or take it as an input.

sentences.en: No assumptions about repo, language, or toolchain anywhere: discover from the repo or take it as an input.
sentences.zh: 任何地方都没有关于存储库、语言或工具链的假设：从存储库中发现或将其作为输入。

content_html_zh:
AI 编码代理的严格工程流程，打包为便携式代理技能：对经过验证的 PR 实施端到端规范，以独立判断（您自己的分支或任何人的 PR）审查代码，像专业作者一样审查反馈，并使文档（面向代理和面向人类）与其描述的代码保持一致。

  • 与线束无关的 — 标准 SKILL.md 目录。 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot 以及越来越多的客户端本地加载它们；在其他任何地方（Windsurf、Goose、拥有终端的人），指向技能文件的一行指针都可以工作。
  • 与代码库无关——对您的存储库、语言或工具链没有任何假设。 构建/测试/lint 命令是从存储库中发现的或作为输入传递，而不是硬编码。
  • 以研究为基础——持久的账本、新鲜的背景审查、证据优先的报告：设计决策追溯到代理工程文献（基本原理）。

旗舰：实现规范

大多数代理可以根据规范编写合理的代码。 他们做的不可靠的是围绕这一点的一切——长期持有计划，测试他们编写的内容，捕捉实现悄悄偏离规范的地方，并证明结果而不是断言它。 Implement-spec 包规定：将一个代理就绪规范交给它，它会自主运行生命周期，仅在最后出现。

spec ─▶ branch ─▶ plan + test matrix ─▶ implement (tests alongside)
     ─▶ two-pass self-review ─▶ gap analysis vs the spec ─▶ close gaps
     ─▶ live verification ─▶ PR + acceptance-criteria evidence report
  • 证据胜于声明——“完成”意味着最终报告中的每个验收标准都映射到可验证的工件（测试、命令的输出、实时检查）——而不是模型这么说的。
  • 长期生存——磁盘上的持久运行分类帐使得运行可以在崩溃和上下文压缩时恢复。
  • 比例严格——每个重量级阶段（账本、自我审查、差距分析、测试、实时验证）都是单独选择退出的，因此单行修复不需要支付十阶段税。

完整的设计原理以及每个阶段背后的文献位于 Skills/implement-spec/README.md 中。

围绕它的技能

与之并存的还有七项技能——其中两项可以跨课程进行扩展，其余的则进行回顾、回答和记录：

Skill 目的
分解规范 将一个大型规范拆分为最少的独立票据，每个票据都适合一个新的环境，并播种一个持久的构建分类帐 - 多会话构建的规划部分
编排-构建 推动分类账完成：在新的上下文中通过实施规范运行每张票据，报告进度，暂停干预，完成整个构建的顶点 - 执行一半
自我检讨 对自己的分支进行两遍审查，PR 前：机械验证，然后是保留独立性的设计批评
评论公关 回顾别人的 PR：CI/验证落地、专注设计+安全通行证、校准严重性、高精度内嵌评论
地址-公关-评论 处理对 PR 的审核反馈：对每个线程进行分类，用证据修复或反驳，用提交链接回复
代理文档 引导或刷新 AGENTS.md 层次结构 - 面向代理的知识层
刷新仓库文档 根据代码审核和同步面向人的文档（自述文件、文档/、示例）

多会话构建

当规范对于一次集中运行而言太大时，decompose-spec 和 Orchestrate-build 将其转换为可恢复的 PR 链 - Implement-spec 仍然是按票工作人员，在新的上下文中按票运行一次：

  • decompose-spec 是规划者，是整个构建的质量上限：它将规范划分为一个精确的目标——最少的票数，使得每个都适合一个具有严格空间的新上下文，并且没有削减切断共享的隐式决策——然后在新的上下文中审查它自己的分割，并为构建分类账播种。 这两个界限（上面的上下文腐烂，下面的支离破碎的决策）追溯到基本原理。
  • Orchestrate-build 是驱动程序。 它的关键举措：排序是确定性代码 - 一个可移植的循环（drive-build.sh，发现 claude -p / goose run / codex exec / gemini -p），不保留任何状态并将每个票证分派到新的上下文 - 因此没有任何内容会在构建过程中积累上下文，并且不会出现长期存在的代理上下文。 状态存在于账本中；人类会在票证边界处暂停并通过编辑进行干预。 降级为每票一个子座席或手动新鲜会话楼层，其中安全带提供的服务较少；基本原理涵盖了为什么它与线束无关。

审查套件

同一张桌子上的三个座位，共享一个认识论——每一个标志都必须是可证明的，精确性胜过回忆（误报是审稿人失去房间的原因）：

  • 自我审查是作者预 PR：第 1 遍运行自动发现的构建/测试/lint（通过 verify.sh，当存储库未声明工具链时推断工具链）加上二进制检查表；第 2 阶段是独立规则下的设计批判——在新的环境中，线束支持子代理，在不支持的情况下，采用磁盘证据规则。 还实施规范的审查阶段。
  • review-pr 是审阅者的席位：以 CI 和（可选）本地验证为基础，然后针对正确性、设计、安全性和范围分别进行重点传递；通过可论证性→信心→新颖性→实质性来控制的发现，标记为阻塞/重要/nit/问题，上限以防止警报疲劳，并与建议块一起发布。 它告诉我们——批准仍然是人性的。
  • 地址-公关-评论是作者的回答：每个未解决的线程都会得到修复、提交链接、合理的推回、答案或范围内的后续行动 - 永远不会沉默，永远不会阿谀奉承，永远不会在审核中强行推动。

文档对

相同的融合理念，两个具有不同消费者和质量标准的语料库——每个语料库在法学硕士工作之前都有一个确定性的、CI 可门控的漂移检测器：

  • agent-docs 拥有其他技能运行的面向代理的知识层（AGENTS.md 层次结构）。 两种模式——引导（侦察→陷阱挖掘→生成）和刷新（漂移分类→外科修复）——由检测器自动选择，该检测器将损坏的引用分类为过时与使用 git 历史记录编写错误。 拥有共享的文档创作指南。
  • fresh-repo-docs 拥有人类阅读的内容：README、docs/、CHANGELOG、指南、示例。 它的检测器会标记损坏的引用和早于它们引用的代码的文档；审计的范围是证据（标记文档，而不是“阅读整个存储库”），结果被归类为陈旧/粗糙/差距/模式漂移，Diátaxis 作为每个文档的质量镜头，并且没有未经验证的声明。

安装

作为克劳德代码插件：

/plugin marketplace add SteveVitali/agent-skills
/plugin install agent-skills@agent-skills

或者通过符号链接，对于在磁盘上发现技能的任何客户端（~/.claude/skills/、项目的 .agents/skills/ 等）：

git clone https://github.com/SteveVitali/agent-skills.git ~/agent-skills
ln -s ~/agent-skills/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/

没有本地技能支持的客户端（例如 Windsurf）：指向技能文件的单行工作流程或规则就足够了 - “阅读并遵循 <path>/skills/implement-spec/SKILL.md”。

每个技能都在 SKILL.md frontmatter 中声明其输入；用自然语言陈述它们（“实现 docs/spec.md，跳过分类帐，脱离主干”）。 系统要求：git、bash 3.2+ 和标准 Unix 工具； PR 技能（评论-公关、地址-公关-评论）还需要经过身份验证的 GitHub CLI (gh)。

仓库布局

.claude-plugin/              # plugin + marketplace manifests (Claude Code)
skills/<skill-name>/
├── SKILL.md             # entry point (Agent Skills format: frontmatter + steps)
├── README.md            # design rationale (where it exists)
├── modes/               # mode-specific step files, loaded on demand (where applicable)
├── scripts/             # supporting shell helpers (bash 3.2+ compatible)
└── checklists/          # supporting checklists / shared reference docs (where applicable)

一个可预测的条目文件名意味着代理（或工具）指向技能/知道每项技能从哪里开始；技能目录中的其他所有内容都是从其 SKILL.md 引用的渐进式披露材料。

设计原则

  • 上下文中的持久状态——任何必须在压缩或崩溃中幸存下来的东西都会写入磁盘（运行分类帐、快照、报告），而不仅仅是在上下文中。
  • 外部验证优于自我评估——编译器、测试和实时系统是仲裁者；代理人在没有证据的情况下声称“已完成”将被视为未完成。
  • 判断独立性——审查尽可能在新的环境中进行，并且总是根据磁盘上的内容而不是编写它的记忆来争论。
  • LLM 之前的确定性——廉价的、退出代码门控的脚本处理所有机械问题（漂移检测、工具链检查），因此模型判断仅在需要判断的地方进行。
  • 渐进式披露——中心文件保持较小；模式文件、指南和清单仅在需要时加载。
  • 比例严格——每个重量级阶段都可以选择退出，因此单行修复不需要支付十阶段税。

创作新技能

  1. 使用 frontmatter 创建 Skills/<name>/SKILL.md：名称、描述（它的作用以及何时使用它）和输入（每个都有名称、必需、描述）。 保持身体安全带中立——技能文件中没有特定于工具的指令。
  2. 编写足够具体的指令以进行验证（“运行 X，期望退出 0”），并校准到前沿模型：指定内容和原因，而不是击键级别的方式。
  3. 如果技能接近 SKILL.md 规范的 ~500 行上限或具有不同的模式，则分为集线器 + 模式/文件（请参阅代理文档）。
  4. Shell 帮助程序位于 script/ 中：bash 3.2 兼容、自包含、默认只读 - 任何变化都必须在其标头中说明，并且已知的限制也属于标头。
  5. 任何地方都没有关于存储库、语言或工具链的假设：从存储库中发现或将其作为输入。
